skills.detail:
When you have a Treasure Area:
A mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect and a chance to inflict Recovery Blocked.
Transforms your Treasure Area into a Woods-Woods Treasure Area (up to 5 spots).
Woods-Woods Treasure Areas can damage enemies within a certain area and have a chance to inflict Recovery Blocked.
The Woods-Woods transformation will disappear after the Treasure is captured, after a certain amount of time passes, or after you are KO'd.

When you have no Treasure Area:
A mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect and a chance to inflict Recovery Blocked.

Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: I Warned You, Didn't I?!

skills.detail:
When your team's Treasure Area is being captured:
While the skill button is held down, reduce damage received from enemies, and perform a long-range multiple hit area attack with a chance to inflict Recovery Blocked.
Also, perform a multiple hit area attack with a chance to inflict Recovery Blocked to enemies around your team's closest Treasure Area that is being captured by the enemy (up to 1 spot).

When your team's Treasure Area is not being captured:
While the skill button is held down, reduce damage received from enemies, and perform a long-range multiple hit area attack with a chance to inflict Recovery Blocked.

The attack ends after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released.

Damage dealt will disregard damage reduction.
Attack ignores obstacles.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
This Skill cannot be used in some locations where there are obstacles overhead.
